flimsy.linePrev: I could feel everything in me
flimsy.line: Pushing for certains, certains are flimsy
stanza: The truth is I don't know, it's so deep
I know nothing, I used to think
Things were so clear, I was so near to nowhere
I could feel everything in me
Pushing for certains, certains are flimsy
Tells me there's no ground at all
